Smartphone Price in Bangladesh 2026

Smartphone price in Bangladesh starts from around 19,499 BDT for an entry level Android and goes up to 2,20,000 BDT for a flagship iPhone. With 4G now universal and 5G expanding, smartphones have become the primary device for work, study, banking, content creation, and entertainment across Bangladesh. At Sumash Tech you get 100% authentic smartphones from 19 brands with official warranty, EMI, and fast delivery nationwide. Browse by brand below or use the buying guide to find the right phone for your budget.

Smartphones by Brand at Sumash Tech

We carry smartphones across every price point from every major brand available in Bangladesh. Go straight to the brand you want or read the brand guide below.

Premium Flagships

  • iPhone: Apple's iOS lineup from iPhone 15 to iPhone 16 Pro Max. The strongest choice for performance, camera quality, long software support, and ecosystem integration. Official Apple Warranty models available.
  • Samsung: The most popular Android brand in Bangladesh. Galaxy A series for budget and mid-range, Galaxy S series for flagship performance, Galaxy Z Fold and Flip for foldable. Nationwide service centers.
  • Google: Pixel phones with AI-powered cameras, clean stock Android, and the fastest OS updates direct from Google. Best pure Android experience available.

Performance and Value

  • OnePlus: Fast processors, smooth OxygenOS software, and industry-leading charging speeds. Strong mid-range to premium Android option.
  • Xiaomi: Flagship-level specs at mid-range prices. Redmi sub-brand leads the budget segment. Popular for gaming, media, and value-focused buyers.
  • Asus: ROG Phone series for serious mobile gamers who need desktop-class processors, active cooling, and high refresh rate displays.
  • Motorola: Clean Android experience, reliable build quality, and strong battery life. One of the best options for users who want a no-fuss phone.
  • Nothing: Unique transparent design with fast, stock-like Android software and a distinctive look that stands out from the competition.

Camera and Style Focus

  • Oppo: Known for camera hardware and fast charging. Find Me and Reno series offer strong mid-range camera performance.
  • Vivo: Selfie-focused cameras, slim designs, and fast charging. Popular among young buyers and content creators.
  • Honor: Solid build quality, strong cameras, and clean software at competitive prices. A reliable mid-range choice.
  • Huawei: Premium design and capable cameras. Strong option for users already in the Huawei ecosystem.
  • Meizu: Design-forward Android phones with smooth software and a minimalist aesthetic.

Budget and Everyday Picks

  • Realme: Fast processors and large batteries at budget prices. Popular with students and first-time smartphone buyers.
  • Infinix: Large displays, big batteries, and modern design at very affordable prices. A strong pick for everyday use and social media in the budget segment.
  • Tecno: Budget and mid-range Android phones with reliable cameras and long battery life. Popular among value-conscious buyers across Bangladesh.
  • Lenovo: Performance-focused smartphones with large batteries for heavy daily users.
  • Nokia: Clean Android software and durable build quality in budget and mid-range smartphones.
  • ZTE: Mid-range Android phones with solid connectivity features including 5G support.
  • Energizer: Built for extreme battery life, capable of lasting two days or more on a single charge.
  • Benco: Entry-level smartphones covering everyday calling, messaging, and basic app use at affordable prices.

How to Choose a Smartphone in Bangladesh

By budget

  • Under 20,000 BDT: Entry-level Android for everyday use. Look for at least 4GB RAM, 64GB storage, and a 5,000 mAh battery. Samsung Galaxy A, Realme C, and Xiaomi Redmi lead this range.
  • 20,000 to 40,000 BDT: The mid-range sweet spot. You get AMOLED displays, 50MP cameras, 5G on some models, and 8GB RAM. Xiaomi, OnePlus Nord, Oppo, and Honor are strong here.
  • 40,000 to 80,000 BDT: Upper mid-range with near-flagship specs. Google Pixel, Samsung Galaxy A and S entry models, and OnePlus flagships sit here.
  • Above 80,000 BDT: Flagship territory. iPhone 15, iPhone 16, Samsung Galaxy S25, and Google Pixel 9 Pro all land here with the best cameras, processors, and software support available.

By use case

  • Photography: iPhone 16 Pro Max, Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra, and Google Pixel 9 Pro are the top three camera phones available in Bangladesh right now.
  • Gaming: Asus ROG Phone, Xiaomi gaming variants, and Samsung Galaxy S series with their high refresh rate AMOLED displays handle PUBG Mobile, Free Fire, and COD Mobile with ease.
  • Business and productivity: iPhone and Samsung Galaxy S offer the strongest security, enterprise app support, and long-term OS updates, making them the safest investments for professional use.
  • Students and everyday users: Realme, Xiaomi Redmi, and Samsung Galaxy A give you the best combination of battery, camera, and performance in the 15,000 to 30,000 BDT range.
  • 5G readiness: If you want a phone that is ready for Bangladesh's expanding 5G network, look for Xiaomi, Samsung, OnePlus, and Honor models in the 30,000 BDT and above range that carry 5G bands.

What to Check Before Buying a Smartphone in Bangladesh

  • Display: AMOLED gives deeper blacks and better battery efficiency than LCD. A 90Hz or 120Hz refresh rate makes scrolling and gaming noticeably smoother.
  • Processor: Snapdragon and MediaTek Dimensity are the two main Android chip families. Higher-tier chips like the Snapdragon 8 Gen series and Dimensity 9000+ handle heavy gaming and multitasking better. Apple's A-series Bionic chip leads overall performance.
  • Battery and charging: In Bangladesh, where power cuts can happen, a 5,000 mAh or larger battery is worth prioritizing. Fast charging above 33W cuts full charge time to under an hour on most phones.
  • RAM and storage: 8GB RAM is the practical minimum for smooth multitasking in 2026. For storage, 128GB is the entry point, while 256GB is more future-proof if you shoot a lot of photos or videos.
  • Network support: Check that the model you are buying supports the 4G and 5G bands used by Bangladeshi operators, particularly Grameenphone, Robi, Banglalink, and Teletalk.

Frequently Asked Questions

1. What is the price of a smartphone in Bangladesh in 2026? 
Smartphone price in Bangladesh starts from around 19,499 BDT for entry-level Android models and goes up to 2,20,000 BDT for flagship iPhones.

2. Which smartphone brand is most popular in Bangladesh? 
Samsung is the most popular Android brand by sales volume. Apple iPhone leads the premium segment. Xiaomi and Realme dominate the budget and mid-range.

3. What is the best smartphone under 20,000 BDT in Bangladesh?
Samsung Galaxy A15, Xiaomi Redmi Note 13, and Realme C series offer the best specs, battery, and camera in this price range.

4. Are iPhones officially available in Bangladesh? 
Yes. Sumash Tech sells official Apple Warranty iPhones with full after-sales support in Bangladesh.

5. Which smartphone has the best camera in Bangladesh? 
iPhone 16 Pro Max, Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra, and Google Pixel 9 Pro are the top camera phones available right now across all lighting conditions.

6. Is 5G smartphone worth buying in Bangladesh in 2026? 
Yes, if your budget is above 30,000 BDT. 5G networks are expanding in Bangladesh and a 5G phone future-proofs your device for the next 3 to 4 years.

7. What RAM is enough for a smartphone in 2026? 
8GB RAM handles everyday tasks, social media, and moderate gaming comfortably. For heavy gaming or professional use, 12GB or more is recommended.

8. How do I avoid buying a grey market phone in Bangladesh? 
Always buy from an authorized retailer like Sumash Tech. Grey market phones often lack local warranty, may not support local 4G/5G bands properly, and have no official after-sales service.

9. Can I buy a smartphone on EMI from Sumash Tech? 
Yes. EMI plans are available on most smartphone models at Sumash Tech with flexible monthly installments.

10. Which Android phone is best for gaming in Bangladesh? 
Asus ROG Phone leads for dedicated mobile gaming. Samsung Galaxy S series and high-end Xiaomi models are strong alternatives with better everyday usability alongside gaming performance.
